title: Access to allergies in an emergency

branches.what: The request comes from a registered clinician with an emergency flag
branches.blocked: The mandate subset cannot express registered-clinician emergency predicates, standing break-glass rules, or mandatory notifications to patient and trusted contact. A scripted emergency permission would bypass the missing checks.
